name: tw02-row
pre: const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const w = v.director.weather; v.director.setHeading(225); v.state.heading = 225; v.state.bankDeg = 0; w.onJump(); await sleep(15000); w.onJump(); await sleep(3000); for (let i = 0; i < 90 && Math.abs(v.state.bankDeg) > 0.5; i++) await sleep(1000); await sleep(4000); const f = v.farTowers; const ob = (v.state.heading + (v.state.seat === 'right' ? 90 : -90)) * Math.PI / 180; const vis = f.towers.filter((t) => { const b = Math.atan2(t.x, -t.z); return Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(b - ob), Math.cos(b - ob))) < 0.44; }); return '航向 ' + v.state.heading.toFixed(0) + ' 坡度 ' + v.state.bankDeg.toFixed(1) + ' active ' + v.director.active + ' | ' + w.describe() + ' | 远塔 ' + f.towers.length + ' 座，窗内 ' + vis.length + '：' + vis.map((t) => Math.round(t.dist) + 'km/顶' + t.top.toFixed(1) + '/砧' + t.anvil.toFixed(2) + '/塔' + t.col.toFixed(2)).join(', ');
